guard_streams.source: Closure of the Release 1B Public Review RFI Consultation
guard_streams.write_limit: The Release 1B closure records historic consultation, mapping validation and procurement steps. It does not verify present-day serviceability or measured speed for current selected parcels.

facts.detail: The closure page was updated on 23 June 2026.
The Release 1B Public Review concluded on 20 September 2021 at 5pm.
BDUK requested evidence from the public, businesses, ISPs and infrastructure providers.
The Public Review began on 19 August 2021.
It covered Suffolk, Norfolk, Shropshire and Telford, and Hampshire and Isle of Wight.
The review aimed to validate the OMR outcome and BDUK mapping.
The preceding OMR ran from 25 March to 22 April 2021.
BDUK's next step was to evaluate all responses.
BDUK planned to finalise intervention areas and publish findings.
The process then proceeds to formal procurement and an Invitation to Tender.

guard_streams.source: Closure of the Third release of Phase 2 Areas Public Reviews
guard_streams.write_limit: The closure is historic consultation and subsidy-targeting evidence. Lot-level mapped eligibility and procurement next steps do not establish current parcel coverage, orderability or measured speed.

facts.detail: The closure page was updated on 23 June 2026.
The Third Release Phase 2 Public Reviews concluded on 18 July 2022 at 5pm.
BDUK requested evidence from the public, businesses, ISPs and infrastructure providers.
The Public Reviews began on 17 June 2022.
The release included West Yorkshire and parts of North Yorkshire, Lot 8.
It included Nottinghamshire and West of Lincolnshire, Lot 10.
It included Leicestershire and Warwickshire, Lot 11.
It included South Yorkshire, Lot 20.
The preceding OMR ran from 4 February to 4 March 2022.
BDUK planned to finalise intervention areas and issue an Invitation to Tender.
